recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-11696 unless a future CDS work-group decision changes the relationship between action.prefix, action.title, and action.linkId.
issue_request: FHIR-11696 was a Published CDS change request for FHIR-core PlanDefinition. It asked whether the old PlanDefinition.actionDefinition.label and PlanDefinition.actionDefinition.title elements should be collapsed because their distinction was unclear. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution kept both concepts and required clarifying documentation.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in commit 6033e337f72c17058027423db9901c1893099510, which explicitly references J#11696 and clarified the PlanDefinition action prefix definition from just a user-visible prefix to a section/item numbering example. The action title definition already described a textual user-facing description.
additional_context: FHIR-13412 had already renamed PlanDefinition.action.label to PlanDefinition.action.prefix and left title in place, so the current issue must be interpreted against prefix/title rather than label/title. PlanDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, current active source has no PlanDefinition.action.label remnant, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no human discussion or minutes contradicting the Jira/source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scoped PlanDefinition source defines action.prefix as a user-visible section/item numbering prefix and action.title as the textual description displayed to a user, which resolves the original ambiguity without redundant prose.

related_jiras.note: Renamed PlanDefinition.action.label to PlanDefinition.action.prefix and left title in place; this explains why FHIR-11696 is now satisfied by the prefix/title definitions rather than by a label/title pair.
